$comment: Policy for scripts/quality/audit_api_evidence.py. Proposed example-eligibility rules for gate G3. An exported class is example-eligible unless a rule below exempts it. Every rule states why; Per-record exemptions use example_exempt/example_exempt_reason in doc/api_registry.json. example_debt lists the eligible registry classes that still lack a built example with an example_snippet; scripts/validate_api_registry.py fails for any other eligible class, and the list and its ceiling may only shrink.

exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/viewers/: Qt widget or view; evidenced by a screenshot scenario and GUI test (G4), not by a compiled console example.
exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/3d/model/: Scene-graph item owned and driven by BrainView; not constructed directly by library users.
exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/3d/workers/: Background worker owned by a real-time view; its behaviour is exercised through the owning view.
exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/3d/core/: Renderer internals behind the BrainView/MultimodalScene facade.
exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/3d/geometry/: Renderer internals behind the BrainView/MultimodalScene facade.
exempt_header_prefixes.viz/backends/qt/3d/input/: Interaction handler of an interactive view; evidenced by GUI tests.

exempt_name_suffixes.Private: Implementation detail behind a public facade.
exempt_name_suffixes.Delegate: Qt item delegate; only meaningful inside a view.
exempt_name_suffixes.Settings: Plain parameter record consumed by an algorithm class; shown inside that class's example.
